question: Match the correct API with its function within the Windows 10 environment.
definitions: This is a cross-platform standard specification for multimedia graphics.
This is a collection of APIs related to multimedia tasks for Microsoft Windows.
This allows applications from older versions of Windows to operate on newer versions.
This is a collection of APIs related to the development of Java programming.

correct_pairs.Open Graphics Library (OpenGL): This is a cross-platform standard specification for multimedia graphics.
correct_pairs.DirectX: This is a collection of APIs related to multimedia tasks for Microsoft Windows.
correct_pairs.Windows APIs: This allows applications from older versions of Windows to operate on newer versions.
correct_pairs.Java APIs: This is a collection of APIs related to the development of Java programming.

question: Match the drive status indicators in the Disk Management utility with their description. (Not all options are used.)
definitions: a volume that is functioning properly
a basic disk that is being converted into a dynamic disk
a disk that does not contain a valid signature
a basic or dynamic disk that is accessible and shows no problems
a dynamic disk that is corrupted or unavailable

correct_pairs.Healthy: a volume that is functioning properly
correct_pairs.Initializing: a basic disk that is being converted into a dynamic disk
correct_pairs.Not Initialized: a disk that does not contain a valid signature
correct_pairs.Online: a basic or dynamic disk that is accessible and shows no problems
correct_pairs.Offline: a dynamic disk that is corrupted or unavailable

question: Match the file system with the respective description.
definitions: Supports partition sizes up to 16 exabytes and incorporates file system security features and extended attributes.
Usually used on flash drives as it can support files larger than 4GB.

Created specifically for optical disk media.

correct_pairs.NTFS: Supports partition sizes up to 16 exabytes and incorporates file system security features and extended attributes.
correct_pairs.ExFAT: Usually used on flash drives as it can support files larger than 4GB.
